title: The planets in order
examples: Which planet do we live on?
What is the order of the planets?
Can you show me the planets from the Sun?

explain.say: The first planet from the Sun is Mercury. It is the smallest planet in our solar system.
Now look! Here it is in 3D: the solar system. Can you see the sun and the mercury? Tap any part, and I will tell you about it.
Next is Venus. Venus is known for its very bright, hot atmosphere.
The third planet is Earth. This is the only planet where life is known to exist.
The fourth planet is Mars. People sometimes call Mars the red planet.
The next group are the giants: Jupiter, Saturn, Uranus, and Neptune. Jupiter is the biggest.
Saturn has beautiful rings around it made of ice and rock. These rings are very visible.

faq.q: Which planet is the biggest one in our solar system?
faq.a: Jupiter is the biggest planet. It is much larger than all the other planets combined.
asks: Which planet is the giant one?

faq.q: What are the rings on Saturn made of?
faq.a: The rings on Saturn are made mostly of chunks of ice and some small pieces of rock.

faq.q: What is the order of the planets from the Sun?
faq.a: The order is Mercury, Venus, Earth, Mars, Jupiter, Saturn, Uranus, and Neptune.
asks: Can you list the planets in order?

faq.a: No, Mercury is the smallest planet. Earth is the third planet from the Sun.

faq.q: Do all the planets have rings?
faq.a: No, not all planets have rings. Saturn has the most visible rings, but other planets might have faint ones.

facts: Mercury is the closest planet to the Sun.
Jupiter is the largest planet in our solar system.
Earth is the third planet from the Sun.
Saturn is famous for its visible ring system.

quiz.say: Which planet is the closest to the Sun?
quiz.why: Mercury is the first planet listed after the Sun.

wrong.0: Mars is the fourth planet from the Sun.
wrong.1: Venus is the second planet from the Sun.
wrong.3: Earth is the third planet, not the first.

quiz.say: Which planet is known for its prominent rings?
quiz.why: Saturn has a very visible system of rings made of ice.

wrong.0: Jupiter has rings, but Saturn's are much more visible.
wrong.1: Uranus's rings are much harder to see.

quiz.say: If you list the planets in order, which planet comes right after Mars?
quiz.why: The order is Mercury, Venus, Earth, Mars, then Jupiter.

wrong.0: Saturn comes after Jupiter in the order.
wrong.1: Earth is before Mars in the sequence.
wrong.2: Neptune is the last planet in the order.
